about_the_game:
A story based campaign with two fictitious protagonists F/Lt Dougie Maxwell (RAAF), a former Blemhiem Mk.1 (F) pilot and F/Sgt Ginger Fenwick is your Geordie navigator from Cramlington in the North East of England. It can be flown as a novice or veteran DCS Mosquito pilot alike and the WWII Asset Pack is not required. Mission types are based upon actual historical records and Mosquito Squadron ORBS (Operations Record Books), as are the weather conditions for the dates your sorties are flown. Missions include Photographic reconnaissance, Path finding, Anti shipping, GEE-H assisted bombing and night fighter operations to name a few. Throughout the campaign your Navigator will perform multiple tasks including tuning the navigational radios. During successful progression of your campaign, your career also progresses to include postings detachments and promotion, all depicted in mini intro missions in addition to the 12 flyable ones.

Key Features:

  • 12 sortie missions based upon historical records.

  • 4 short introductory story based missions.

  • Navigator interaction including setting of navigational radios.

  • F10 map detailed flight plan depictions.

  • Unique in-flight visual representations of both GEE-H and AI Mark VIII radar oscilloscopes.

  • Nearly a thousand voice over’s and images used throughout.

  • Visual interactions with ground crew.

Localization:

  • Voiceovers: English

  • Briefings/Subtitles: English

All required products

• DCS: Mosquito FB VI
• DCS: The Channel Map
